description: Function signatures for a 4-byte selector, and for calldata the decoded arguments. Signatures come from the openchain.xyz database, with 4byte.directory as fallback. Calldata is decoded against each candidate until one fits the selector and the arguments; bigints are returned as strings. Read-only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

data.description: Calldata, 0x followed by hex (at least 4 bytes)

selector.description: Or only the selector: 0x followed by 8 hex characters
